title: Hierarchical Edge Computing in SAGSIN: Multi-Layer Network Architecture and Multi-Level Information Processing
summary: Maritime Internet of Things (IoT) deployments increasingly rely on the space-air-ground-sea integrated network (SAGSIN) to connect underwater sensors with terrestrial and space backbones.
